text: Ko onon yo ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah, ɓe golliri sari'a Makko on ! Wata yimɓe goo e mon jalkitu woɗɓe dey: hino gasa hara ɓen jalkitaaɓe hino ɓuri moƴƴude e mun en ka Allah. Wata rewɓe kadi jalkitu rewɓe : hino gasa ka ɓen jalkitaaɓe ɓurata ɓe moƴƴude ka Allah. Wata on aybin musiɗɓe mon, hiɓe wa'i wa mon. Wata on bugondir kadi jammooje ɗe on yiɗaa, wano yimɓe Madiina anndiranoo ando seenagol Nulaaɗo Allah on (yo o his). Kala e mo'on waɗuɗo ɗum, ko yaltuɗo e ɗoftaare. Sifa ngun jikku ɗon non bonii baawo goɗingol. Kala mo tuubaali e ɗin geddi, ko ɓen woni tooñirɓe ko'e-mun, unagol e halkaare, sabu ɗin geddi maɓɓe.
